frr version 10.4.5_git
frr defaults traditional
hostname br1-r1
no ipv6 forwarding
service integrated-vtysh-config
!
ip prefix-list PL-HQ-R2-IN seq 5 permit 10.10.10.0/24
ip prefix-list PL-HQ-R2-IN seq 10 permit 10.30.10.0/24
ip prefix-list PL-HQ-R2-IN seq 15 permit 10.30.99.0/24
ip prefix-list PL-HQ-R2-OUT seq 5 permit 10.20.10.0/24
!
interface eth1
 description to hq-r2 eth2 (wan-hq-br1)
 ip address 172.16.0.2/30
exit
!
interface eth2
 description LAN br1-users
 ip address 10.20.10.1/24
exit
!
interface lo
 ip address 10.255.0.11/32
exit
!
router bgp 65010
 bgp router-id 10.255.0.11
 neighbor 172.16.0.1 remote-as 65000
 neighbor 172.16.0.1 description hq-r2
 neighbor 172.16.0.1 timers 3 9
 neighbor 172.16.0.1 timers connect 5
 !
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  network 10.20.10.0/24
  neighbor 172.16.0.1 route-map RM-HQ-R2-IN in
  neighbor 172.16.0.1 route-map RM-HQ-R2-OUT out
 exit-address-family
exit
!
route-map RM-HQ-R2-IN permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-HQ-R2-IN
exit
!
route-map RM-HQ-R2-OUT permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-HQ-R2-OUT
exit
!
